python3 -c "
import hopsworks
import pandas as pd
from hsfs.transformation_function import TransformationFunction

# Connect to Hopsworks
project = hopsworks.login()
fs = project.get_feature_store()

# Get feature group
fg = fs.get_feature_group('cctxnc444ca', version=1)

# Define transformation functions
@TransformationFunction(
    name='hour_of_day',
    output_type='int'
)
def hour_of_day(dt):
    return dt.hour

@TransformationFunction(
    name='day_of_week',
    output_type='int'
)
def day_of_week(dt):
    return dt.dayofweek

@TransformationFunction(
    name='amount_z_score',
    output_type='double'
)
def amount_z_score(amount, mean, std):
    return (amount - mean) / std if std != 0 else 0.0

# Register transformations
fs.create_transformation_function(hour_of_day)
fs.create_transformation_function(day_of_week)
fs.create_transformation_function(amount_z_score)

# Apply transformations
fg_transformation = fg.select_all() \
    .join(fg.select(['cc_num', 'amount']), on=['cc_num']) \
    .group_by(['cc_num']) \
    .aggregate({
        'amount': ['mean', 'std']
    }) \
    .join(fg.select_all(), on=['cc_num']) \
    .with_column('hour_of_day', hour_of_day(fg['datetime'])) \
    .with_column('day_of_week', day_of_week(fg['datetime'])) \
    .with_column('amount_z_score', amount_z_score(fg['amount'], fg['amount_mean'], fg['amount_std'])) \
    .select(['transaction_id', 'cc_num', 'datetime', 'amount', 'merchant', 'category', 'lat', 'long', 'is_fraud', 'hour_of_day', 'day_of_week', 'amount_z_score'])

# Create feature view
feature_view = fs.create_feature_view(
    name='cctdc444ca',
    version=1,
    query=fg_transformation,
    labels=['is_fraud']
)

print('Feature view cctdc444ca created.')
"
